human_visual_review: PENDING. D3 flat shading is intentional. D1/D2 remain unchanged; only these local corners are tested.

assistant_visual_findings.method: Direct inspection of the saved D3 geometry montage with enlarged local corner details
findings: The right-hand north return is visible outside D1's existing terminal post and reaches the shallow right-side cap. The same cutaway concept appears at both enclosure corners.
The enclosure retains D1 and D2 material artwork while D3 uses intentional flat scaffold colors; no material mismatch judgment is inferred.

The front remains open. Separate yellow objects and background changes are visible through the side panes. The original and relocated contexts expose the approved-wall/scaffold width step without hiding it.
assistant_visual_findings.limits: Only the two specified local corners and straight repeats are represented; no all-direction or general junction approval.
